Headline: IPO shares of SY Panel Nepal Limited Listed in NEPSE; What is the Opening Ranges?
Full Content:
1,30,81,371 units IPO shares of
SY Panel Nepal Limited (SYPNL)
have been listed in NEPSE. This includes the shares held by promoters and the quantity issued to the general public.
The opening range for the first transaction is Rs. 106.61 to Rs. 319.83. If the company signs an agreement with NEPSE, the IPO shares will be traded in the secondary market from Mangsir 24, 2082.
Out of a total of 1,30,81,371 unit shares, 40,76,156 units of IPO shares with a par value of Rs 100 were issued to the general public from 19th Kartik, 2082 to 23rd Kartik, 2082.
Note that the listed shares will be traded under the symbol 'SYPNL'.

Headline: SY Panel Nepal Limited IPO Allotment Concludes: Lucky 4,07,615 Applicants Allotted 10 Units Each via Lottery System
Full Content:
SY Panel Nepal Limited's IPO allotment was concluded today at the premises of the issue manager, Prabhu Capital Limited, Prabhu Group Building, Kamaladi, Kathmandu.
The company had issued 40,76,156 units as an Initial Public Offering (IPO) to the general public from (19th Kartik, 2082 to 23rd Kartik, 2082).
The issued capital of the company was Rs. 1.30 Arba. Of this, 40%, i.e., 5,232,548 unit shares, were issued to the public. Of the total issued capital, 2%, which amounted to 261,627 unit shares worth Rs. 2.61 Crores, were allotted to project-affected locals of Chitwan district. The remaining 38% of the issued capital, i.e., 4,970,920 unit shares, was allocated to the general public. Of this general public issue, 10%, a total of 497,092 unit shares, had already been allotted to Nepalese citizens working abroad. Of the general public issue, 3%, i.e., 149,127 units, were set aside for the company's employees, and 5% of the total offered shares, i.e., 248,546 units, were set aside for mutual funds. The remaining 4,076,156 units were made available for the general public.
The issue received a total of 20,87,320 valid applications for 2,31,78,470 units. Meanwhile, 18,054 applications for 2,28,650 units were disqualified.
As per the allotment module, 4,07,615 applicants were allotted 10 units each via lottery, and 6 applicants received 1 unit each.

SY Panel Nepal Limited (SYPNL), established in July 2017, produces expanded polystyrene (EPS) and polyurethane foam (PUFF) sandwich panels, UPVC windows, steel doors, and EPS materials, widely used in prefabricated home construction. It is a subsidiary of South Korea-based SY Co. Limited, which holds approximately 63% of the shares, with the remaining stake primarily owned by Korean nationals affiliated with SY Co. Limited. SYPNL’s manufacturing facility is located in Ratnanagar, Chitwan, and the company operates across Nepal through its network of 62 dealers.

Headline: SY Panel Nepal Announces Revised Share Issuance Date for Locals of Chitwan District And Nepalese Employed Abroad
Full Content:
SY Panel Nepal Limited has announced a new date for the issuance and sale of shares allocated to residents of industry-affected areas and Nepali migrant workers abroad.
According to the company, the shares were initially scheduled to open for subscription from 2082/05/29. However, due to the adverse situation in the country, the opening date has been postponed. The share issuance will now officially open from 2082/06/07 for the targeted groups.
The company informed that this issuance aims to ensure participation of locals directly affected by the industry’s operations as well as Nepali citizens contributing from foreign employment. By prioritizing these groups, SY Panel Nepal seeks to promote inclusive growth and shared benefits from the company’s expansion.

Headline: SY Panel Nepal Limited Postpones Share Issuance for Locals of Chitwan District And Nepalese Employed Abroad
Full Content:
SY Panel Nepal Limited has officially announced the postponement of its planned share issuance for residents of Locals of Chitwan District and Nepalese Employed Abroad. According to the company, the shares were scheduled to be issued and opened for sale starting 2082 Bhadra 29. However, owing to the current adverse situation in Nepal, the company has decided to halt the issuance process temporarily.
SY Panel Nepal stated that the share issuance and related processes will only proceed after further notice. The company assured that once conditions become favorable, a new notice regarding the issuance timeline will be published. In its official statement, the company has requested all stakeholders, including locals of the affected regions and Nepali migrant workers who were preparing to apply, to remain patient until the next official announcement.

Headline: SEBON Adds IPO Proposals of These 6 Companies To Its Pipeline; 3 Each from Hydropower, 2 From Other and 1 from Manufacturing Sector
Full Content:
The Securities Board of Nepal (SEBON) has added IPO proposals of six companies in its pipeline.
Apex Hospitality Limited
has submitted a proposal to the capital market regulator to issue 2,400,000 shares. This will raise Rs. 24 crores for the company. The application was submitted on Ashwin 12, 2080.
Himalayan Capital Limited has been appointed the issue manager for the public offering.
Infomerics Credit Rating Nepal Limited (Infomerics Nepal) has assigned the issuer rating of IRN B+ (Is) [Single B Plus (Issuer)]. An issuer with this rating is considered to have a high risk of default regarding the timely servicing of financial obligations.
Similarly,
Jagdamba Steels Limited
has submitted a proposal to the capital market regulator to issue 20,070,000 shares at a premium price which will raise Rs. 6.02 Arba for the company. The application was submitted on Ashwin 17, 2080.
Siddhartha Capital Limited has been appointed the issue manager for the public offering.
Infomerics Credit Rating Nepal (Infomerics Nepal) has assigned the issuer rating of IRN BBB (Is) [Triple B (Issuer)]. An issuer with this rating is considered to have a moderate degree of safety regarding the timely servicing of financial obligations.
Likewise,
SY Panel Nepal Limited
has submitted a proposal to the capital market regulator to issue 5,232,548 shares. This will raise Rs. 52.32 crores for the company. The application was submitted on Ashwin 19, 2080.
Prabhu Capital Limited has been appointed the issue manager for the public offering.
ICRA Nepal has assigned an issuer rating of [ICRANP-IR] BB (pronounced ICRA NP Issuer Rating double B) to SY Panel Nepal Limited, indicating a moderate risk of default regarding timely servicing of financial obligations.
In the same manner
, Mabilung Energy Limited
has submitted a proposal to the capital market regulator to issue 1,890,530 shares. This will raise Rs. 18.90 crores for the company. The application was submitted on 14th Ashwin, 2080.
Laxmi Capital Market Ltd has been appointed the issue manager for the public offering.
ICRA Nepal has assigned the issuer rating of [ICRANP-IR] B+ (pronounced ICRA NP issuer rating B plus) to Mabilung Energy Limited. Issuers with this rating are considered to have a high risk of default regarding the timely servicing of financial obligations.
Meanwhile,
Beni Hydropower Project Limited
has submitted a proposal to the capital market regulator to issue a total of 2,080,000 shares. This will raise Rs. 20.80 crores for the company. The application was submitted on Ashwin 05, 2080.
NMB Capital Limited has been appointed the issue manager for the public offering.
Beni Hydropower (P.) Ltd is a hydropower development company founded in 2016. The company is developing the Upper Solu Khola Hydropower Project, a run-of-river type project with a licensed capacity of 18 MW. The project is located in Beni (Salleri), Solukhumbhu district of Nepal. The project is currently under construction.
The IPO proposal of
Yambaling Hydropower Limited
is in SEBON's pipeline.
The company has submitted a proposal to the capital market regulator to issue a total of 2,800,000 shares. This will raise Rs. 28 crores for the company. The application was submitted on Ashwin 10, 2080.
Muktinath Capital Limited has been appointed the issue manager for the public offering.
CARE Ratings Nepal Limited (CRNL) has assigned an issuer rating of ‘CARE-NP B+ (Is)’ to Yambaling Hydropower Limited (YHL). Issuers with this rating are considered to offer a high risk of default regarding the timely servicing of financial obligations, in Nepal.
